```{=html}
<div class="global-progress-banner relative-box" id="progress-tile">
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
    <div>
      <h2 style="margin-bottom: 2px; font-weight: 800; color: white;">Your Progress</h2>
      <div id="gp-subtext" style="opacity:0.85;font-size:0.95rem; color: white;">0 weeks completed</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mt-3">
    <div class="progress" style="height:22px; flex-grow: 1; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">
      <div id="global-progress-bar" class="progress-bar" role="progressbar" style="width:0%;background-color:#a8d5a2;color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:900;border-radius:50px;"></div>
    </div>

  </div>

<h3 style="color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1.2rem;margin-top:2rem;">Course Content</h3>
<div class="grid" id="week-cards-grid" style="align-items: stretch;"></div>

<script>
const WEEKS = [
  { n:1, title:"Week 1: Basic Data Structures", topics:"Syntax · Variables · Vectors · Matrices · Lists · Dataframes", href:"1_datentypen.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w1_slides","check_w1_vid1","check_w1_vid2","check_w1_vid3","check_w1_md1","check_w1_md2"], quizIds:["w1_q_vectors","w1_q_matrices","w1_q_lists","w1_q_dataframes"], lang:"r" },
  { n:2, title:"Week 2: Data Cleanup & Visualisation", topics:"Loading Data · which · apply · is.na · hist · boxplot · qqnorm", href:"2_data_cleanup.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w2_slides","check_w2_vid1","check_w2_vid2","check_w2_vid3","check_w2_vid4","check_w2_markdown"], quizIds:["w2_q_loading","w2_q_cleanup","w2_q_viz","w2_q_exercises"], lang:"r" },
  { n:3, title:"Week 3: Correlation & Clustering", topics:"Pearson vs Spearman · Missing Data · Intro to Clustering · K-means", href:"3_correlation_clustering.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w3_slides","check_w3_vid1","check_w3_vid2","check_w3_vid3","check_w3_vid4","check_w3_md"], quizIds:["w3_q_correlation","w3_q_missing","w3_q_clustering","w3_q_kmeans","w3_q_plenum"], lang:"r" },
  { n:4, title:"Week 4: Hierarchical Clustering & PCA", topics:"Dendrograms · Linkage Methods · PCA · Scree Plots · Loadings", href:"4_unsupervised_learning.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w4_slides","check_w4_vid1","check_w4_vid2","check_w4_vid3","check_w4_md"], quizIds:["w4_q_hclust","w4_q_pca","w4_q_together"], lang:"r" },
  { n:5, title:"Week 5: Probability Distributions", topics:"Random Variables · p/d/q/r Functions · Binomial · Poisson · Normal · t-Distribution", href:"5_probability_distributions.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w5_slides","check_w5_vid1","check_w5_vid2","check_w5_vid3","check_w5_md"], quizIds:["w5_q_functions","w5_q_binomial","w5_q_poisson","w5_q_normal","w5_q_relationships"], lang:"r" },
  { n:6, title:"Week 6: CLT & Confidence Intervals", topics:"Central Limit Theorem · Standard Error · Confidence Intervals", href:"6_clt_confidence_intervals.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w6_slides","check_w6_vid1","check_w6_vid2","check_w6_md"], quizIds:["w6_q_clt","w6_q_se","w6_q_ci","w6_q_plenum"], lang:"r" },
  { n:7, title:"Week 7: Hypothesis Testing & t-Tests", topics:"H0/H1 · One- vs Two-Sided · t-Test · Normality", href:"7_hypothesis_testing.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w7_slides","check_w7_vid1","check_w7_vid2","check_w7_md"], quizIds:["w7_q_hypotheses","w7_q_ttest","w7_q_normality","w7_q_null"], lang:"r" },
  { n:8, title:"Week 8: Non-Parametric & Proportion Tests", topics:"Wilcoxon Test · Fisher/Chi-Square · Power of a Test", href:"8_nonparametric_proportion_tests.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w8_slides","check_w8_vid1","check_w8_vid2","check_w8_vid3","check_w8_md"], quizIds:["w8_q_nonparam","w8_q_proportion","w8_q_power","w8_q_errors"], lang:"r" },
  { n:9, title:"Week 9: Regression Analysis", topics:"Linear Regression · Multiple Regression · RMSE · F-Test", href:"9_regression_analysis.html", unlocked:true, checkIds:["check_w9_slides","check_w9_vid1","check_w9_vid2","check_w9_vid3","check_w9_vid4","check_w9_vid5","check_w9_md"], quizIds:["w9_q_simple","w9_q_multiple","w9_q_evaluation","w9_q_ftest"], lang:"r" }
];

function getLang() {
  try { return localStorage.getItem('da_course_lang') || 'python'; } catch(e) { return 'python'; }
}

function calculateWeekProgress(week) {
  const hasChunks = !!week.chunkCount;
  const hasChecks = !!(week.checkIds?.length);
  if (!hasChunks && !hasChecks) return null;
  const lang = week.lang || getLang();
  const total = (week.chunkCount || 0) + (week.checkIds?.length || 0) + (week.quizIds?.length || 0);
  let done = 0;
  const isDone = (key) => { try { return localStorage.getItem(key) === 'true'; } catch(e) { return false; } };
  if (hasChunks) for (let i = 1; i <= week.chunkCount; i++) if (isDone(`chunk_${lang}_w${week.n}_c${i}`)) done++;
  week.checkIds?.forEach(cid => { if (isDone(cid)) done++; });
  week.quizIds?.forEach(qid => { if (isDone(`quiz_${lang}_w${week.n}_${qid}`)) done++; });
  return { done, total, pct: Math.round((done / total) * 100) };
}

function statusLabel(p, locked) {
  if (locked) return '🔒 Locked';
  if (!p || p.done === 0) return '⬜ Not started';
  return p.pct === 100 ? '✅ Completed' : `🔄 ${p.done}/${p.total} done`;
}

function renderWeekCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('week-cards-grid');
  if (!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = '';

  WEEKS.forEach(week => {
    const p = calculateWeekProgress(week);
    const col = document.createElement('div');
    col.className = 'g-col-12 g-col-sm-6 g-col-md-4';

    const contentLocked = !week.unlocked;

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'week-card p-3' + (contentLocked ? ' opacity-50' : '');
    if (!contentLocked && week.href) {
      card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      card.onclick = () => { window.location.href = week.href; };
    }

    const pct = p ? p.pct : 0;
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="week-card-title">${week.title}</div>
      <div class="week-card-topics">${week.topics}</div>
      <div class="week-card-status">${statusLabel(p, contentLocked)}</div>
      ${p ? `<div class="week-card-progress-bar-bg mt-2"><div class="week-card-progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>` : ''}
    `;
    col.appendChild(card);
    grid.appendChild(col);
  });
}

function updateGlobalUI() {
  let total = 0, done = 0, completedW = 0;
  WEEKS.filter(w => w.unlocked && (w.chunkCount || w.checkIds?.length)).forEach(w => {
    const p = calculateWeekProgress(w);
    if (p) { total += p.total; done += p.done; if (p.pct === 100) completedW++; }
  });
  const gPct = total > 0 ? Math.round((done / total) * 100) : 0;
  document.getElementById('global-progress-bar').style.width = gPct + '%';
  document.getElementById('gp-percent-badge').innerText = gPct + '%';
  document.getElementById('gp-subtext').innerText = `${completedW} weeks completed`;
}

renderWeekCards();
updateGlobalUI();
</script>
```
